source.text_it: Si deve in particolare regolare la velocità nelle ore notturne

records.localized_text: Speed must be adjusted especially at night.

records.localized_text: Speed must be adjusted especially when the following vehicle has a larger engine displacement.

records.localized_text: Speed must be adjusted especially when travelling on a one-way road.

source.text_it: Si deve in particolare regolare la velocità solo nei giorni festivi

records.localized_text: Speed must be adjusted especially only on Sundays and public holidays.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza va rispettata per non tamponare il veicolo che ci precede

records.localized_text: The safety distance must be observed in order not to rear-end the vehicle ahead of us

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza dipende dalla prontezza di riflessi del conducente

records.localized_text: The safety distance depends on the driver's speed of reaction.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza deve essere calcolata in base alla velocità del proprio veicolo

records.localized_text: The safety distance must be calculated according to the speed of one's own vehicle.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza è una distanza fissa

records.localized_text: The safety distance is a fixed distance

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza si deve rispettare solo al di sopra dei 30 km/h

records.localized_text: The safety distance needs to be maintained only above 30 km/h.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza deve essere mantenuta solo tra ciclomotori

records.localized_text: The safety distance needs to be maintained only between mopeds.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza può dipendere dalla velocità del proprio veicolo

records.localized_text: The safety distance may depend on the speed of one's own vehicle.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza può dipendere dal tempo di reazione del conducente

records.localized_text: The safety distance may depend on the driver's reaction time.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza può dipendere dall'efficienza dei freni

records.localized_text: The safety distance may depend on brake efficiency.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza può dipendere dalle condizioni dei pneumatici

records.localized_text: The safety distance may depend on tyre condition.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza può dipendere dalla larghezza della strada

records.localized_text: The safety distance may depend on road width.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza può dipendere dalla presenza di veicoli che ci seguono

records.localized_text: The safety distance may depend on the presence of vehicles behind us.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza deve essere tale da evitare il tamponamento del veicolo che precede

records.localized_text: The safety distance must be sufficient to avoid colliding with the rear of the vehicle ahead.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza deve essere adeguata allo stato di efficienza del veicolo

records.localized_text: The safety distance must be appropriate to the vehicle's operating condition.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza deve consentire in ogni caso l'arresto tempestivo del veicolo

records.localized_text: The safety distance must always allow the vehicle to stop promptly.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza non deve mai essere inferiore a 150 m

records.localized_text: The safety distance must never be less than 150 m.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza non dipende dalla velocità del veicolo

records.localized_text: The safety distance does not depend on vehicle speed.

source.text_it: La distanza di sicurezza deve essere mantenuta solo tra i quadricicli a motore

records.localized_text: The safety distance must be maintained only between motorised quadricycles.

source.text_it: E' vietato il sorpasso quando non si dispone di uno spazio libero sufficiente

records.localized_text: Overtaking is prohibited when there is insufficient clear space.

rows.text: Visibility may be reduced at night, so adjust speed to keep control and stop in time.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 141 commi 1-3, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php: velocità adeguata alle circostanze e particolare attenzione nelle ore notturne.

rows.text: The following vehicle’s engine size is not the criterion for choosing speed; road and traffic conditions and other relevant circumstances matter.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 141 commi 1-3, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php: velocità adeguata alle circostanze e particolare attenzione nelle ore notturne.

rows.text: A one-way street alone does not call for a special speed adjustment; speed must still suit actual conditions such as visibility and traffic.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 141 commi 1-3, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php: velocità adeguata alle circostanze e particolare attenzione nelle ore notturne.

rows.text: Speed must suit the circumstances every day, not only on public holidays.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 141 commi 1-3, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-141.php: velocità adeguata alle circostanze e particolare attenzione nelle ore notturne.

rows.text: The gap to the vehicle ahead must allow you to stop in time if it slows or stops, avoiding a rear-end collision.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 149 comma 1, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-149/: distanza dal veicolo che precede sufficiente all’arresto tempestivo e a evitare collisioni.

rows.text: The vehicle travels during the reaction before braking; slower reactions require more distance to respond.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 149 comma 1, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-149/: distanza dal veicolo che precede sufficiente all’arresto tempestivo e a evitare collisioni.

evidence: Codice della strada, art. 149 comma 1, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-149/: distanza dal veicolo che precede sufficiente all’arresto tempestivo e a evitare collisioni.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. The gap to the vehicle ahead must allow you to stop in time, taking speed, reaction and conditions into account. The wording does not clarify possible indirect effects of road width.
evidence: Official AM source, PDF viewer page 122, question 26499: printed FALSO. https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DomandeAM.pdf/112daa18-5efc-441d-8c15-640556a28ef4
Codice della strada art. 149(1): forward gap must allow timely stopping and avoid collision. https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-149/

DPR 495/1992 art. 348(1), ACI publication, PDF page 195: distance accounts for speed, reaction, traffic, road alignment, weather, vehicle and other influential circumstances. https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/regolamento_codice_della_strada.pdf

Editorial note: the quiz’s intended contrast between the forward stopping gap and road width is an inference, not an authoritative interpretation of its “può dipendere” wording. Neither provision categorically excludes indirect effects of road width; the learner text states that limit explicitly.

rows.text: Overtaking requires enough clear space to complete the manoeuvre safely; if there is not enough, do not start.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148 commi 2 e 10, https://www.aci.it/fileadmin/cds/art-148.php: spazio libero sufficiente, sorpasso già iniziato da chi segue e divieto presso i dossi con eccezioni.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE. On a road with a single carriageway and one lane in each direction, overtaking near a crest is prohibited. The question does not specify the number of carriageways, however: the Code also provides an exception for roads with two separate carriageways and appropriate road markings.
evidence: Quiz ufficiale AM, quesito 26508, PDF SHA-256 61d1e0516b972526401615d9cde18e8b2e60de754a70a97dca9edfb2c4347b30, pagina 122: verdetto VERO; non specifica il numero di carreggiate.

Codice della strada, art. 148 comma 10, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-148/: divieto presso i dossi ed eccezioni, incluse le strade a due carreggiate separate con apposita segnaletica orizzontale. La carreggiata unica è un’ipotesi interpretativa, non un dettaglio espresso nel quesito.

rows.text: Before overtaking, check that no driver following on the same carriageway or half-carriageway has already begun overtaking; if it is divided into lanes, check the lane immediately to your left.
evidence: Codice della strada, art. 148(2)(c), ACI: verifica dell’assenza di sorpasso già iniziato dal conducente che segue sulla stessa carreggiata o semicarreggiata, o sulla corsia immediatamente a sinistra se suddivisa in corsie. https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-148/

issues: 26499: The question says road width may affect the distance, but the explanation only says width alone does not determine it; this does not refute the possibility. Article 348 requires regard for road geometry and other influential circumstances, while the official quiz's FALSO establishes the verdict rather than the claimed causal rule. Provide authoritative support for a precise correction or block the row.

26500: The question says following vehicles may affect the distance, but the explanation only says their mere presence does not determine it; this does not refute a possible influence. Article 348 includes traffic and other influential circumstances, and the cited FALSO verdict is not evidence of a causal rule. Provide authoritative support for a precise correction or block the row.

26508: The explanation treats a two-way road with one lane each way as automatically outside the article 148(10) exception. The cited provision also lists a road with two separate carriageways, so the two-lane wording alone does not establish that no exception can apply. Reconcile the printed verdict with the precise road configuration and exceptions using authoritative evidence.

issues.reason: The explanation states without qualification that any following driver already overtaking must prevent the maneuver and that the two maneuvers would otherwise interfere. Article 148(2)(c) specifies the same carriageway or half-carriageway, or the immediately adjacent left lane when subdivided into lanes. State the applicable condition rather than the blanket inference.

The cited Polizia di Stato examination PDF returns an access-denied page in the review browser; its claimed contents could not be independently verified. Remove the inaccessible supplementary citation if the verified DPR 495/1992 art. 348 and other accessible sources fully support each claim, or provide an inspectable verified copy.
